summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Seller Coaching System v1. All 13 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests verified nudges display correctly in SellerDashboard and DealManagement pages. Exclusivity warning dialog works with proper criteria cards (green/red) and buyer metrics.

backend: GET /api/coaching/exclusivity-check/deal_hot_seo_01/buyer_vc_london_01 returns ready=false (bad buyer, <3 criteria, has warnings)
GET /api/coaching/nudges/deal/deal_interest_creative_02 returns NC-02 (5 interests, 0 LOIs) as ALTA priority
GET /api/coaching/nudges/deal/deal_dead_tech_04 returns NC-01 (deal sin traccion >7 days, 0 NDAs) as ALTA
GET /api/coaching/nudges/deal/deal_loi_sin_act_05 returns NC-03 (LOI sin DR downloads) as MEDIA
GET /api/coaching/nudges (seller elena.romero@techstudio.es) returns cross-deal nudges including NC-01 for dead deal
GET /api/coaching/nudges (seller nuria.costa@brillocreativo.cat) returns NC-02 + NC-04 nudges
Seller nudges are sorted by priority (ALTA first, then MEDIA, then BAJA)
GET /api/exports/documentacion returns 200 and a valid ZIP file (27KB with 5 docs)
Coaching endpoints require authentication (401 without token)
frontend: SellerDashboard shows 'Senales del sistema' section with nudges
Nudge cards colored correctly: ALTA=red, MEDIA=amber, BAJA=blue
NC-02 'Interes sin conversion' displays with ALTA priority badge
NC-04 'Buyer inactivo' displays with BAJA priority badge
NC-01 'Deal sin traccion' displays for dead deal seller
DealManagement comparator tab shows deal-specific nudges
Exclusivity warning dialog appears when clicking lock button
Dialog shows buyer name and criteria met (e.g., '4/4 criterios recomendados')
Dialog shows 4 criteria cards with green/red backgrounds based on status
Criteria cards show: LOI status, Intent Score, DR downloads, Time invested
Dialog has Cancel and Confirm buttons with proper data-testid attributes
Comparator table shows engagement rows with buyer info and actions

context_for_next_testing_agent: Seller Coaching System v1 fully tested and working. Key features: 1) Exclusivity pre-check returns ready/not-ready with buyer metrics and criteria (4 criteria: LOI, intent score >=55, DR downloads >=1, time >=10min), 2) Deal nudges: NC-01 (dead deal), NC-02 (interest without LOI), NC-03 (LOI without DD), NC-04 (inactive buyer), NC-05 (exclusivity without progress), 3) Seller cross-deal nudges aggregated and sorted by priority, 4) Frontend displays nudges with colored cards and exclusivity warning dialog with criteria visualization.
